title: Back-to-back, 2x550m on tired legs
coachNotes: The second half of the back-to-back is where the adaptation lives. Legs will be poor for the first 20 minutes, that is expected and not a reason to abort. Climb effort one notch below Saturday. Descend with short strides and cadence above 170, no braking, poles if you have them. Hard abort: stop after loop 1 on any lateral knee signal and log it. Loop 2 is optional, the weekend already worked without it.
